positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
I work in Customer Trust space, where I build and maintain services that help detecting frauds and
abuses on Amazon retail websites, determine restrictions that should be applied to risky sellers and
buyers, and execute enforcements on their accounts.

I design, develop, handle operations and support partner teams who depend on mentioned services;
mentor junior engineers; work with program managers and stakeholders on prioritization and planning.

Java, Typescript, AWS technologies.
